title: Treat mock callbacks as incomplete integration evidence
problemCues: Scaffolded or demo data layer claims a workflow is done
preconditions: Workflow mutates or loads product data
decision: Require real consumer adapter bindings for persist/load paths. Adapter-only scaffolds are starting points, not completion proof. Auth, policy, and media pipelines stay behind explicit adapters.
exceptions: Isolated fixtures explicitly labeled synthetic for teaching or held-out scoring
validatedBy: Usability/completion evidence names the adapter; mock-only success fails the pilot gate
